# Wacaiki Fashion Editorial & Monograph Platform

> Wacaiki is a modern high-craft fashion editorial and publishing monograph platform, featuring essays on quiet luxury, architectural tailorship, street style, and sustainable material innovation.

## Primary Sections
- Home Journal: https://wacaiki.com/
- Fall Collection Trends: https://wacaiki.com/?category=Fall%20Collection
- Fashion & Runway: https://wacaiki.com/?category=Fashion
- CMS Studio Management: https://wacaiki.com/cms

## API Documentation
- Public Blogs API: https://wacaiki.com/api/blogs
- JWT Auth Login: https://wacaiki.com/api/auth/login
- Cloudinary Upload API: https://wacaiki.com/api/upload
